n8c56221b0d.summary: Shares in FTSE 250-listed Currys rose by about a third in early Monday trading after the company attracted takeover interest.

n84f1a1579a.headline: JD.com joins takeover battle of Britain's Currys
n84f1a1579a.summary: China's JD.com said it was evaluating a takeover of Britain's Currys, sending the retailer's shares soaring. The move lays the ground for a bidding war after Currys rejected a rival US$883 million deal.
n84f1a1579a.why: Currys is a UK electricals retailer listed in London, and JD.com is one of China's largest e-commerce companies. Takeover contests can lift target share prices and shift valuations across the sector.

nb5ce72727d.headline: EDF faces €12.9bn hit over Hinkley Point C setbacks
